hook: One thousand falsified corporate papers hid billions in assets for Roman Abramovich.

sections.voiceover: One thousand falsified corporate papers hid billions in assets for Roman Abramovich.
b_roll: Stack of corporate documents on a dark desk
Close-up of forged signatures on paper

sections.voiceover: Deloitte Cyprus executed retroactive transfers to bypass strict tax laws. Meritservus spun off to process the paperwork. Where did the $672 million in vanished assets go?
b_roll: Office building in Cyprus with glass facade

sections.voiceover: Worse, accounts signed off by Deloitte erased superyachts and private jets completely.
Deloitte Cyprus concealed $672 million in billionaire wealth successfully. Meritservus changed ownership documents retroactively.
b_roll: Financial audit charts showing sudden drops

sections.voiceover: Corporate secrecy shields billion-dollar fortunes from public tax scrutiny.
